editorial:
Imagine being sent halfway across the world by your parents just to learn about your roots. That is exactly what happens to the main character in this sweet story. You follow her as she lands in Taipei, feeling like a total fish out of water. The vibe is very cozy and lighthearted, mixing the struggle of learning a new language with the excitement of exploring a huge city. You will really feel for her as she tries to fit in and finds herself falling for a local guy who shows her the real side of the city beyond the tourist spots.

The acting feels natural and the chemistry between the leads is the best part of the whole experience. While the plot follows some predictable romantic tropes, it stays charming and never feels boring. You might find some parts a bit slow, but the beautiful scenery makes up for it. If you want something relaxing, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move. It is a perfect pick for a rainy weekend.
endingExplained: After a lot of back and forth and some misunderstandings, the main character finally realizes that her identity is not just about where she was born. She decides to embrace her heritage and her feelings for her love interest. They end up together in a heartfelt scene that proves love wins over distance. Everything wraps up happily as she finds a balance between her American life and her new love for Taipei.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cute romantic comedies and travel stories.
